## About
TC Auto Service is an auto repair shop in North Las Vegas, registered with the state of Nevada. Linton owns the shop, and one customer described him as "very honest and straight forward."
Our staff knows how to handle the problems that commonly affect vehicles, from AC and heat to timing belts and steering racks. We can tailor service options to the age and condition of your car, and we use only high-quality parts and products.
Customers rate us 4.7 on Google from 243 reviews. If you live in North Las Vegas or one of the surrounding areas, give us a call and let us know how we can help.

## Services
- Auto AC and Heat Repair: Cooling and heating repair for your car's climate system.
- Ball joints & control arms: Front end parts that keep your steering and ride steady.
- Bolted On Catalytic Converters: Replacement of bolted on catalytic converters.
- Head gasket repair: Head gasket work when your engine is losing coolant or running hot.
- Radiators & Radiator Hoses: Radiator and hose repair to keep your cooling system sealed.
- Shock & strut replacement: New shocks and struts for a steadier ride.
- Steering rack repair: Steering rack work so your car tracks and turns the way it should.
- Timing Chain and Timing Belts: Timing chain and timing belt service for your engine.
